headline: Iran‑US Tensions Escalate as Drone Strikes Hit Gulf Bases and Threaten Stability
subheadline: Hezbollah rockets hit Israeli positions in Kfar Tibnit, prompting airstrikes that killed a Lebanese soldier, and Iran launched drones targeting US ammunition depots in Kuwait.
lede: Israeli forces struck Hezbollah positions near the Lebanon border, killing a Lebanese soldier. Iran conducted drone strikes on US Army ammunition depots in Kuwait and Patriot radar systems, while the US warned Iran after two American soldiers were killed by Iranian missiles in Jordan. Hezbollah launched rockets at Israeli positions in Kfar Tibnit, prompting retaliatory airstrikes. Israeli artillery shells also killed a Palestinian woman and injured her daughter in Gaza City.

sections.title: Crimea‑Based Missiles Target Odesa, Ukraine
sections.body: Russian missile launches from Crimea struck Odesa, damaging port infrastructure and residential areas, resulting in two fatalities and three injuries. Ukrainian forces targeted Russian logistics facilities in Moscow and Tambov, 500 km from the front line, aiming at components for drones and navigation equipment. Multiple Russian drones were detected over Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Sumy, with ballistic missile threats reported from northern, eastern, and southern directions. Russian ground forces advanced near Volokhivka and began fighting for Zakharivka in Kharkiv, while 'Rubikon' units were redeployed to protect the shadow fleet.

sections.title: Iran‑US Drone Strikes Escalate Regional Tensions
sections.body: Israeli forces struck Hezbollah positions near the Lebanon border, killing a Lebanese soldier. Hezbollah launched rockets at Israeli positions in Kfar Tibnit, prompting airstrikes. Iran conducted retaliatory drone strikes targeting US Army ammunition depots in Kuwait and Patriot radar systems, and claimed attacks on US bases in Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan with suicide drones. Israeli artillery shells killed a Palestinian woman and injured her daughter in Gaza City.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran’s multi‑domain attacks on US bases in the Gulf and the US warning about Iran’s nuclear program signal a significant escalation of hostilities. The involvement of Hezbollah and the cross‑border rocket exchanges further complicate regional stability, raising the risk of a broader conflict.
